header.title: Play & Relax
header.sub: A calm activity corner — take a break, then get on with your day.

note: These activities are here for a gentle pause or a bit of distraction. They are not treatment and they do not cure anything — if things feel heavy, please talk to someone you trust or reach out for professional support.

games.title: Mini-games
games.sub: Light distractions for when you need a few minutes away from everything.

relax.title: Relaxing activities
relax.sub: Quieter ways to slow down for a moment.

footerNote: Everything here runs only on this device. Scores are just for fun — there is nothing to lose and no reason to rush.

runner.title: Endless runner
runner.body: Hop a little round friend over soft bushes. Your score climbs with distance.

match.title: Match-three
match.body: Swap neighbouring tiles to line up three or more, all in calm colours.

memory.title: Memory match
memory.body: Find all eight pairs on a 4×4 board. Slow and steady absolutely counts.

focus.title: Focus reaction
focus.body: A 20-second round of soft targets. Tap them as they drift in — no rush.

colour.title: Colouring canvas
colour.body: Colour a blank page with the Inner Circle palette. No skill required.

jar.title: Calm jar
jar.body: Shake the jar and watch the glitter settle — like thoughts settling too.

mindful.title: Short mindfulness
mindful.body: Three tiny prompts — sounds, contact, breath. About one quiet minute.

moment.title: Positive moment
moment.body: Write down one good thing and keep it in your mood journey.

toast.niceWork: Nice work taking a moment for yourself.
toast.chain: Nice chain — they keep falling into place.
toast.foundAll: You found every pair — lovely focus. Nice work taking a moment for yourself.
toast.freshPage: Fresh page — nice work taking a moment for yourself.
toast.settled: Watched it settle — nice work taking a moment for yourself.

runner.canvasLabel: Endless runner: a small round character jumping over bushes
runner.readyBody: Press Space or tap to jump over the bushes. No pressure — go as far as you like.
runner.overNewBest: You covered {{score}} points — a new best!
runner.overHint: Take a breath, then go again whenever you're ready.
runner.footer: Space, Arrow Up or a tap to jump. The speed picks up a little as you go.

match.footer: Tap a tile, then an adjacent one to swap. Lines of three or more clear and new tiles fall in.

memory.winBody: You did it in {{moves}} moves. That kind of quiet focus is a genuinely good reset.
memory.footer: Flip two cards at a time and try to remember where each pair lives.

focus.targetLabel: Soft target, click for a point
focus.readyBody: Gentle targets drift in — tap them for a point. Nothing flashes, nothing is lost.
focus.overNewBest: You caught {{score}} targets — a new best!
focus.footer: A short, gentle round — just tap whatever appears. Stop whenever you like.

colour.footer: Draw with a mouse, finger or stylus. There is no wrong way to fill the page.

jar.rest: All settled. Shake it whenever you need a pause.
jar.footer: Watch the glitter drift down and find its rest — like thoughts settling on their own.

0.title: Notice three things you can hear
0.body: Wherever you are right now, let your ears do a little work. One near sound, one further away, and one you had not noticed until this moment.
0.cue: You do not need to name them perfectly — just let them arrive.

1.title: Feel two points of contact
1.body: Notice your feet resting on the floor, and your back or shoulders touching the chair. Let those points hold you for a few slow seconds.
1.cue: Nothing to fix. Just two places where the world is holding you up.

2.title: Take one unhurried breath
2.body: Breathe in gently, and let the out-breath be a little longer than the in-breath. Once is enough. Twice, if it feels nice.
2.cue: That is the whole exercise — short, quiet, and entirely yours.

mindful.doneBody: Three small steps, about a minute of your day. You showed up for yourself — that genuinely counts. Come back whenever the day feels loud.

prompts.0: A friend messaged at the right moment…
prompts.1: I finished something I had been putting off…
prompts.2: The weather felt good on a walk…
prompts.3: I was kind to myself, just once…

moment.intro: What is one small good thing from today? It can be tiny — a sip of good chai, a song, a message that landed well.
moment.error: Write a line or two — even a few words are enough.
moment.label: Your positive moment
moment.savedTitle: Nice work taking a moment for yourself
moment.savedBody: Your moment is saved to your mood journey. Small good things are worth writing down — they add up more than we expect.
moment.footer: Saved only in this browser, alongside your other tiny wins.
